title: Event-Driven Domain Handoff: ORDER_PAID to Fulfillment Allocation
invariantSummary: Following receipt of event 'ORDER_PAID', the newly spawned agent-fulfillment-worker proposes 'allocateInventory' from 'unfulfilled'. The proposal satisfies all invariants within the fulfillment domain and transitions to 'inventory_allocated'.

expectedVerdictDetails.feedback: Proposal successfully validated! Legal transition from 'unfulfilled' to 'inventory_allocated' via 'ALLOCATE_INVENTORY' in domain 'fulfillment'. Conforms to GraphQL mutation 'allocateInventory'.
